name: Automatic APT Updates
vulnerability: APT package-list refreshes and unattended package upgrades are not both enabled.
fix: Install unattended-upgrades and set APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists and APT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade to 1 in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades.
fixedMessage: Automatic APT Updates is configured correctly
